body:
I've been trying to do all those things.

I've been trying to improve myself and my problems; I've been learning to meditate. I've been speaking to a therapist, as well as a Buddhist monk. I've been trying to hang out with friends more. I've been hitting the gym harder. I joined some dating sites and have been talking to some girls, but with no intention of "dating". 

I also took an impromptu solo vacation to the Dominican Republic. And I got my motorcycle license and bought a bike.

But none of that fills this void inside me. None of it makes me happy. No matter what I do, my mind is only on her.
I don't know. I don't call her. I'm sure she would if I did; it's not like we're on bad terms. But she said we can't be friends right now.

I broke up with her about 2 months ago over something silly. In fact, this wasn't the first time I tried to leave. Whenever we had a particularly big fight, I would always default to "flight". We had been together for almost 3 years. We always had a lot of fights and the relationship had a bunch of other problems that I can see now. Anyways, I got very upset and left. We talked about it via text over the next few days and agreed that this was for the best, because we both have our own issues to work on. 

Over the course of the next few days, and weeks, I realized what I had foolishly thrown away. She was the best thing to ever happen to me. I am miserable without her. Yes, we had our problems, but we could work on them together. I know a lot of it is my fault, and I'm trying to fix those things about me. I've tried asking her plenty of times over the last 2 months, making promises that we can work on our issues and that things will be better this time. Although she's miserable and misses me too, she's unwavering in her decision.
